__comment: The robot item is the entity's own cube: an 8x8x8 box centred in the model space, wrapped in the same 32x32 skin net RenderRobot uses. The chassis cube and the display sizes live in robot_chassis_base (which this model parents); texture is the textures/item/ copy of robot_base.png so it lands on a listed atlas source (entity textures are bound as whole files and are not stitched). Per-board icons: 1.21.10+ select models/item/robot_<kind>.json through the custom_data condition chain in items/robot.json; 1.21.1 (which ignores items/*.json) dispatches through the buildcraftunofficial:board overrides predicate below. Both are pinned to RoboticsItemVariants by RoboticsItemIconCoverageTester.
